description: Region-aware binding continuity, mandatory intent for newly introduced bytes, and binding verification states
rationale: The review identified file-wide rebinding cost, unknown-provenance escape hatches, and conflation of preserve claims with verification as the next blockers before treating this as agent infrastructure
requirements: Unaffected bindings must not require new revisions when equal-region mapping uniquely preserves their bytes
Newly introduced after-bytes require at least one binding even under unknown provenance
Binding verification status must distinguish declared, pending, verified, failed, and unverifiable claims
title: ChatGPT review hardening
